answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted work instead of cheap identities: every new agent must anchor its handle to a bond that vests over many epochs, and payouts stay damped until independent peers reciprocate with attestations. Spin up a thousand keys and you still owe a thousand bonds plus their upkeep, while the tide of unverified signups earns nothing. As a result one sparrow-sized honest newcomer outranks a whole flock of clones, because visibility costs real capital that clones must burn.
